name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

profile.notes: The game this engine was retargeted to; every value here was measured on its dump.

comments.builds.0.main_base: after rtld's 0x20000 bytes in Eden's layout (nx2/image.py)
comments.lift.patch_modules: the order lift.py has always installed them in: two modules may add C at one site, in this order
comments.profile.gfx.frame_limiter: int: the rate f_8042cd20 sleeps to
comments.profile.gfx.nominal_fps: int: the nominal rate the engine steps game time by (60 / it)
comments.profile.gfx.vrr_mode: byte: logged beside the gate; 1 in every run seen
comments.profile.gfx.vrr_gate: byte: f_804fc0f0 stores a rate into +0xfc only while this is set
comments.profile.gfx.controller: the adaptive controller's object; the words below are offsets inside it
comments.profile.gfx.controller_words: what HOS_FPS_LOG prints: all four read 60 at 60 fps
comments.profile.upscale.network_keep: 9dc98871 resolves the dynamic-resolution scene to 2048x1152; left out, the 3D picture is black under the HUD
comments.profile.hooks.gfx_clock: main+0x346c770: after the bl of the graphics module's frame-end GetSystemTick
comments.profile.npad_players: Ocarina reads Npad No.1 alone, with every device merged into it
comments.profile.account_users: one user, "Player": the one there always was
comments.profile.romfs_needed: (Longshot #534 and #863) the build reads Pack/ZsDic.pack.zs and System/Resource (prompt_assets.py, shader_census.py), and the game cannot start without its heap definition, which it opens as Product. then Default. (#689 and a player's v3.0.0-rc.4: a romfs with no System folder crashed at boot every time, "write 0x100000000000, guest 0", its heaps set up without their sizes; that file alone missing does too)
comments.saves_dir: Ocarina's saves folder on Linux has always been hookshot; every other game's is hookshot-<key>
